description: Use this when the user has made, or wants to record, a dilution from a bottle they own; the material used is taken from the source bottle's stock. This makes a stock bottle, not a formula concentration change. The source bottle's existing strength determines the source and solvent grams; the target cannot be stronger than the source.

deductFromSource.description: Whether to deduct the source grams used from shelf stock. Defaults to true; false records stock without that deduction.

grams.description: Total grams of the finished new stock dilution, not grams of solvent to add or a formula batch size.

name: make_dilution
title: Make a dilution from stock
